name: @khorsheed/dsh-story-bible
description: 长篇小说写作模式的作品记忆核心：作品注册表 + 记忆/角色/伏笔/章节 store、Remote 数据面 story、三个 story_* 工具、focus 轻指引函数段与 story skill（M1 无浏览器面）

compat.notes: M1 is host-only by design: it declares no dsh.client browser half, so the 右栏两 tab land with M3 — the Remote data face `story` is mounted now and serves any consumer. State lives under $DSH_HOME/state/story (deployment-level, never a session workspace): every mutation goes through the mounted ctx.fs with the CALLING SESSION's resolved MODE and session id but the writable boundary re-rooted at the plugin's own state dir (the canvas store precedent), so a read-only deployment still denies. The per-session focus map (sessionId → workId) is in-memory only — a restart means 「nothing focused yet」, which the pointer section and the tools answer honestly (empty section / guidance text, never a throw). The light pointer is a FUNCTION prompt section (host §4.1's native contract) evaluated per assembly; with no focus it renders '' and costs nothing. 章节正文 reads (workspace markdown, the single source of truth) go through ctx.fs unfenced because a fence is a write fence. story_extract's subagent delegation is the main agent's own job (host-native subagent tool): the plugin never delegates, and a preset without the subagent tool degrades to the main agent running prepare/import itself (the five import gates are plugin service code either way).
